chain_words.nuance: cheerful and inclined to joke, in a light-hearted way
fond of games and teasing, without serious intent
quick and clever in producing amusing remarks
intelligent and quick to understand or solve problems
exceptionally intelligent or impressive in ability

explanation: These words all describe lively intelligence, from a light-hearted joking manner to an exceptional and striking ability.

usage_notes.difference: 'Witty' describes quick, amusing wording; 'clever' describes general intelligence or skill, which need not involve humour.
